book.name: 1 Jon
book.title: La-ukei ta JON ramen iy atorou ma bwena

content: Jises Krais badeh, ta aseben taha mari

Aha naduk, jo atorou la-ukei ramen dah ewek taha, ta aha samekes kandriyen ndra-in. Arile, buku are lau ndramesekei kandriyen ndra-in badeh, Kindrei winiyan mani kandriyen ndra-in tan nane iu, tasah seben tataha badeh, in aliy, nyaran Jises Krais. Iy ari kandriyen ndra-in badan bwe. Ma iy badeh, in hawe tama taha Kindrei, ma iy asehek sahou i tan, ta iy karuwani iri kandriyen ndra-in tataha mari nane ki-iu.
Ya, Krais le badeh, i nyara salom ta sikine ma mani kandriyen ndra-in tataha mari iu. Iy amekes lahou doh badeh, ta aseben taha le bwe, iy amekes ta aseben lau mara-ei badu kon munyak.
Taha tanan lakou dah: Buku taha a-en hamon tiri batanau tan, taha ndrame ndratanan iy ai.

Buku ari ndramak asehek anya, “Jo ta Kindrei handru ma jo tanan iy,” arile, iy ba-en hamon tiri sahou, nane Kindrei edeu eme tataha ta a-en hamon ta aliy bwai, sebwe iy ndramak doh ta wendreya. Ma sahou ta Kindrei handru badeh, bado ndrinen bwe.
Arile, buku are lau in hamon ta sahou ta Kindrei handru, iy badeh, leheya so-ok ta Kindrei udu bolo kandriyen tan eme lewan. Ta san le doh, taha atanan buku taha a-en hamon ta Kindrei handru.
Ya, buku are lau anya, “Jo ta Kindrei” o “Kindrei udu hawek,” tekedek ma hawe kandriyen tan mara-ei badeh, ki buku le ta Jises.
Batanau ha-un
Wurah lomada aha kawas tek, jo batorou batanau ha-un bawek taha bwe, batanau malen le mene, kabatana aha asahan lau ta Kindrei. Sahou batanau malen doh badeh, aha ndranuhun ndra bwena labai.
Arile, jo badeh, atorou batanau ha-un ewek taha; ma aha anyolom moson ta aliy badeh, udu tan ma aha ale, tasah lulik anya ki-iu ai, ya lomada sun handru ndranya.
Buku ari ndramak anya, iy badu lomada sun, arile iy badeh, baso-ok iri lau ta Kindrei rayah ja bwe, ya iy ndramak doh badeh, udu ndra bolo lulik kahis.
Are lau mwan o badih, iy aso-ok nadu tinen iri rayah ja, iy doh badeh, udu bolo lomada sun, ma ari lakou ja winiyan batawi iy ta amekes are lau taku ja bwai.

Arile, are lau mwan o badih, buku iy baso-ok nadu tinen iri rayah ja bwe, iy badeh, edek ili eme udu ndra bolo lulik kahis; iy bala tanan, ta iy ilih heh bwe, tasah lulik badeh, ndrabwidi madan ndralik.

content.text: Ado naduk, jo atorou la-ukei dah ewek tado,
tasah Kindrei badeh ndramani kandriyen ndra-in taha ndra-au na gok ta Krais mene ndramesekei.
Ado tama, jo atorou la-ukei dah ewek tado,
tasah aha tanan Jises Krais, iy ndra bwena labai.
Ado lau loweu, jo atorou la-ukei ewek tado,
tasah aha ndrales boto-on ndrareu hawe Kindrei,
Ado nah nadu bwisik, jo atorou la-ukei ewek tado,
tasah ado ndratanan tama taha Kindrei.
Ado tama, jo atorou la-ukei ewek tado,
tasah ado ndratanan iy badeh, ndrasahan bwena labai.
Ado lau loweu, jo atorou la-ukei ewek tado,
ma sahou ta Kindrei badeh, ereu bolo aha,

content: Mada aha salikis kandriyen ta kon munyak, ma hawe iri lakou mari badu kon munyak. Buku ari ndramak, iy aso-ok kandriyen ma lakou badu munyak tinan labai, iy badeh, baso-ok lakou Kindrei aso-ok, bwe.

Taha tana taha iri kandriyen ta lau badu munyak badeh, buku none: Ade iri a len, ma mada iri alikis, hawe kandriyen ta bar ndra-in anya, “Jo le ai, jo le ai.” Kandriyen mari doh badeh, bareu ta Kindrei bame bwe. Iri kandriyen doh badeh, badu kon munyak le.
Ya kon munyak dah, ma lakou mari ale lau aso-ok, anya kamai ki-iu ai. Arile, are lau amekes kandriyen Kindrei aso-ok, kameh ereu le buku doh.
Lau ta kaliu hawe Laban badeh, ndrasahan

Wurah lomada ado naduk ta nyara Krais, len ta munyak dah ta udu badeh, ndrame mirihik labai ta ano ai. Buku none aha ndranuhun, lau ta kaliu hawe Krais kameh asahan. Ya, idah, iri lau solo-an ta kaliu hawe Krais ndrasahan ai. Eme ma taha ndratana taha, len ta munyak ta ano badeh, ndrame mirihik ai.

Bwena iri lau doh badu hawe taha, ya idah iri ndraruwani taha. Idoh ndraleheyaniy, iri lau doh badu hawe taha bwe. Ki buku none iri lau tataha handru eh, iri kameh winiyan baruwani taha bwe. Arile, iri ndraruwani taha, ya aha ndratanan, iri lau doh badeh, badu hawe taha bwe.
Arile, Krais ndrasolowei Malawin Ndrabun ndrawek la-u aha, ma aha mari ndratanan sahou handru.
Jo batorou bawek taha bwe, tasah aha bala tanan ta sahou handru bwe, arile tasah, aha ndratanan iy, ma wasai winiyan basahan sahou handru bwe.
Are lau iri ta wasai? Iri lau le nane ale bisini anya Jises badeh, Mesaya
bwe. Iri lau buku doh badeh, iri ta wasai, iri batehei Kindrei uru nadun Jises Krais badeh, bado ndrine iri bwe. Eme ma iri asahan lau ta kaliu hawe Krais.
Are lau ale, atehei konan i ta Nadu Kindrei, badeh, ili ta taman Kindrei ale. Are lau ale, atehei ndrinen handru, in ta Nadu Kindrei, badeh, kameh in ta taman ale.
Aha kanyolom ma kabudon saba lakou mene, aha anuhun udu ndra bada katin, udu ndrine aha kahis deh bwe. Buku udu aliy eh, aha ale badeh, ado hawe Jises Krais uru taman Kindrei.
Ma, iy ndratandrakan ta edeu kohan handru eme tataha, kameh ta udu le buku doh.
Jo atorou iri sahou dah ewek taha, ta asehek nyala aha, ta mada aha kaleu, kora-on iri lau ta wasai kawendreyani aha.

Arile, aha badeh, barah ta tanan bwe. Aha ndrakohok Malawin Ndrabun ta Krais, eme ma iy doh leheya aha ta lakou mari ta Kindrei. Ya sahou tan doh handru, iy bawasai bwe. Eme ma aha katawi Krais kihis, buku none le Malawin Ndrabun ndraleheya aha.

Ya, aha naduk ta Kindrei, aha katehei budon taha kihis ki-in ta Krais, ma aha ka-en hamon tan. Tasah, buku iy eme hamon eme kon munyak dah ja, kora-on bwili aha sama ta kandriyen mene aha ndramesekei, ma aha anoh ta anyolom iy. Aha kasekesek ta an hamon tan, ma aha kameh sekesek ta anyolom iy.
Aha ndratanan, Krais badeh, mwasin handru. Iy ari kandriyen ndra-in badan bwe-en. Ya, buku aha atou iri mwan ma badih rayah amekes kandriyen mwasin, aha ndratanan, iri badeh, nadu Kindrei ale.

footnotes.text: Boho iri Grik, iri aloh Krais. Boho iri Hiburu iri aloh Mesaya. Moso boho kon ma la-uh doh badeh, i le randrah: Ndramak Kindrei atehei iy eme ta asahan kabin ma ta aseben iri lau tan marakon ame hamon. Ou winiyan anyolom udu bolo tarou ta Jon 5:1 ale.
